# awscc_ivs_ad_configuration (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::IVS::AdConfiguration



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Ad configuration ARN.
- `media_tailor_playback_configurations` (Attributes List) List of integration configurations with MediaTailor resources. The first item in the list is the default playback configuration used for the ad configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--media_tailor_playback_configurations))
- `name` (String) Ad configuration name. The value does not need to be unique.
- `post_roll_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration for the post-roll ad break to use for this ad configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--post_roll_configuration))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags attached to the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--media_tailor_playback_configurations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `media_tailor_playback_configurations`

Read-Only:

- `playback_configuration_arn` (String) ARN of the customer-created EMT PlaybackConfiguration resource in the same region and account.


<a id="nestedatt--post_roll_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `post_roll_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `duration_seconds` (Number) Duration of the post-roll ad break, in seconds.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the post-roll ad configuration is enabled.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
